plainTranslation: With Composite Pluto in the 10th house, you may struggle over power and control of the way you're perceived together, of the direction you're going in together, and of your common goals. In a personal relationship, you need to allow one another to pursue your own goals without interference. In a business relationship, one of you may try to take control, but you need to be respectful.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
